name: Proto-Dravidian (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY / SUBSTRATE NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Dravidian is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Dravidian family (South, Central, North Dravidian). It is referenced here as the leading candidate substrate of the Indo-Aryan languages: the retroflex series that distinguishes Indo-Aryan from the rest of Indo-European is widely attributed to Dravidian (and Munda) substratal influence. Glottolog drav1251. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Krishnamurti, Bh.
